=== owners.POST.yml ===
composition:
  authorize: "hasRole('OWNER_ADMIN')"

# Validate required fields first, so a missing/blank field is a 400 listing the
# offending field names before any entity is built or persisted.
validate:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.ValidateNewOwner
  next: resolveHousehold

# A household is same last name at the same address (case-insensitive, whitespace collapsed).
# Read-only step: publishes the household's stable 'householdId' (part of the identity key)
# for the steps below. It no longer rejects on its own. Runs before any entity is persisted.
resolveHousehold:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.ResolveHousehold
  next: uniqueIdentity

# Single duplicate-detection gate: derive the new owner's identityKey
# (normalizedTelephone + '|' + email + '|' + householdId) and reject the create with a 409
# when its WHOLE key equals an existing owner's. Runs before any entity is persisted.
uniqueIdentity:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.ValidateUniqueIdentity
  next: cityCapacity

# Reject a create whose city already contains 50 or more owners with a 409, before any
# entity is built or persisted.
cityCapacity:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.ValidateCityCapacity
  next: dailyLimit

# Reject a create once 100 or more owners have already been created today (by
# registrationDate) with a 429, before any entity is built or persisted.
dailyLimit:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.ValidateDailyOwnerLimit
  next: applyHousehold

# When joining a shared household, back-fill the published 'householdId' onto existing members
# so the whole household carries the same id. A no-op otherwise.
applyHousehold:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.ApplySharedHousehold
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: build

build:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.BuildOwner
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: save

save:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.SaveOwner
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: audit

# Emit the audit line after the owner is saved (id populated) and before responding,
# keeping the audit side effect in its own step rather than in the responder.
audit:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.AuditOwnerCreated
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: bulkWarning

# Populate the response-only bulkSignupWarning flag from the count of owners created today
# (this owner is now saved and counted).
bulkWarning:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.FlagBulkSignup
  govern: [ transaction ]
  next: respond

respond:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.RespondWithOwnerCreated
  govern: [ transaction ]

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[0-9]*$'
          example: '6085551023'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. Stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the owner was registered. Defaults to the server's current date when not supplied. Returned in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        sharesHousehold:
          title: Shares household
          description: >-
            Write-only flag. Deprecated and ignored: duplicate detection is now the single
            identityKey check, and because the telephone is part of that key two members of
            the same household with different telephones are always allowed. Owners sharing a
            last name at the same address are grouped under a shared householdId regardless.
          type: boolean
          writeOnly: true
          example: false
      required:
        - firstName
        - lastName
        - address
        - city
        - telephone
    Owner:
      title: Owner
      description: A pet owner.
      allOf:
        - $ref: '#/components/schemas/OwnerFields'
        - type: object
          properties:
            id:
              title: ID
              description: The ID of the pet owner.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            displayName:
              title: Display name
              description: The owner's name formatted as 'LastName, FirstName'.
              type: string
              example: 'Franklin, George'
              readOnly: true
            initials:
              title: Initials
              description: The upper-cased first letters of firstName and lastName, dot-separated with a trailing dot.
              type: string
              example: 'G.F.'
              readOnly: true
            customerCode:
              title: Customer code
              description: The owner's customer code, formatted '<CITY3>-<LAST3>-<NNNN>' where CITY3 is the upper-cased first three letters of the city, LAST3 the upper-cased first three letters of lastName and NNNN a per-city 4-digit zero-padded sequence.
              type: string
              example: 'LON-SMI-0007'
              readOnly: true
            membershipNumber:
              title: Membership number
              description: The owner's membership number, formatted '<customerCode>-M<YY>' where YY is the last two digits of the registrationDate year.
              type: string
              example: 'LON-SMI-0007-M26'
              readOnly: true
            householdId:
              title: Household ID
              description: A stable shared identifier assigned to owners that share a household (same last name at the same address). Owners not in a shared household have no household ID.
              type: string
              example: 'A1B2C3D4E5F6'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:
              title: Identity key
              description: >-
                The owner's derived duplicate-detection key, formatted
                'normalizedTelephone|email|householdId' (the email and householdId segments are
                empty when absent). Two owners are duplicates only when their whole identity keys
                are equal; such a create is rejected with 409.
              type: string
              example: '+61412345678||A1B2C3D4E5F6'
              readOnly: true
            namesakeCount:
              title: Namesake count
              description: The number of existing owners that, at the moment this owner was created, shared the same first and last name (compared case-insensitively). Fixed at creation time.
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 0
              example: 1
              readOnly: true
            membershipLevel:
              title: Membership level
              description: The owner's numeric membership level, fixed at creation. Starts at 1; adds 1 when an email is present; adds 1 when namesakeCount is 0; capped at 3 (level 4 is reserved for tenure).
              type: integer
              format: int32
              minimum: 1
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:
              title: Locality
              description: The canonical region derived from the city using a fixed city-to-region table (Sydney->NSW, Melbourne->VIC, Brisbane->QLD), or 'UNKNOWN' when the city is not in the table.
              type: string
              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            bulkSignupWarning:
              title: Bulk signup warning
              description: True when more than 80 owners have already been created today (counted by registrationDate for the current business day), otherwise false.
              type: boolean
              example: false
              readOnly: true
            contactPreference:
              title: Contact preference
              description: The owner's preferred contact channel, 'EMAIL' when an email is present, otherwise 'PHONE'.
              type: string
              example: 'EMAIL'
              readOnly: true
            pets:
              title: Pets
              description: The pets owned by this individual including any booked vet visits.
              type: array
              items:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Pet'
              readOnly: true
          required:
            - pets

# when its WHOLE key equals an existing owner's. Runs before any entity is persisted.
uniqueIdentity:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.ValidateUniqueIdentity
  next: cityCapacity

# Reject a create whose city already contains 50 or more owners with a 409, before any

cityCapacity:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.ValidateCityCapacity
  next: dailyLimit

# Reject a create once 100 or more owners have already been created today (by

dailyLimit:
  class: org.springframework.samples.petclinic.rest.function.owner.ValidateDailyOwnerLimit
  next: applyHousehold

## Summary

I added an optional, city-aware `postcode` field to owners, validated only when present.

**Contract / persistence**
- `openapi.yml` — added `postcode` to the `OwnerFields` schema (pattern `^[0-9]{4}$`, *not* in `required`), so it flows into both the request and response DTOs and stays backward-compatible.
- `model/Owner.java` — new `postcode` column + getter/setter. MapStruct auto-maps it by name in both directions, so it's stored on create and returned on read.
- `db/{hsqldb,h2,mysql,postgres}/schema.sql` — added a `postcode` column (tests use hsqldb).

**Validation (OfficeFloor function injection, per AGENTS.md)**
- `OwnerPostcode` — the single shared rule authority: absent → accepted; present must be 4 digits; for a city with a known region (Sydney→NSW 2000-2099, Melbourne→VIC 3000-3099, Brisbane→QLD 4000-4099) it must be in range; a city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode.
- `ValidatePostcode` — a small step reading the published `OwnerFieldsDto`, throwing the checked `InvalidPostcodeException` when invalid.
- `InvalidPostcodeException` + `InvalidPostcodeExceptionHandler` + escalation YAML — responds `400 {"errors":["postcode"]}`, matching the existing telephone/email error shape.
- Wired `validatePostcode` into both the `POST /api/owners` and `PUT /api/owners/{ownerId}` pipelines (right after body validation, before load/persist). `ApplyOwner` now also writes `postcode` on update.

**One bug caught during testing**: `java.util.Map.of(...).get(key)` throws NPE on a `null` key, so looking up an unknown city's region and feeding `null` into the range map 500'd. Fixed by null-guarding the region lookup before the range lookup.

A valid postcode is stored/returned, an owner without a postcode is still accepted, and a malformed/out-of-range postcode is rejected with 400.

Note: I made the PUT path handle `postcode` too (validate-when-present + store) for spec consistency, since the spec speaks of owners generally rather than only creation — the tests only exercise POST, but this keeps the two write paths aligned. Let me know if you'd prefer PUT left untouched.
